ambiguity.note: A window is ~10 kb, so even 100 ppm puts ~1 ambiguous base in a typical window, and two contiguous codes take a confident window from 1.000 to 0.000. genomes_over_100ppm is the count at material risk under the n-channel default. EDL933, the known failure, is 1,182 ppm.

interpretation: frac_elements_unreachable is recall the tool cannot achieve at any threshold or operating point, because the sequence is never examined. If it is non-trivial the short-contig path needs fixing before any recall figure is quoted for fragmented assemblies; if it is ~0 on this corpus, the risk is specific to MAG and draft input rather than to the benchmark, and a warning suffices.
